why: QA E14: every production fix carries LIVE MATURITY n/N = consecutive passing production cycles since it went live, one per cadence slot. Operator 11-11 15:15 ET.
verified_against: release dirs, deployment_log, n8n_runs receipts and lane_registry read 2026-11-11 ~15:30 ET

semantics.cycle: one expected slot of the item's cadence.cron (ET). Extra runs inside a slot are not extra cycles; a live failure off a slot still resets n.
semantics.silent: a slot past its grace with no usable live receipt is recorded as missed, resets n to 0 and is shown first as SILENT. This is a reset, not a hold: a streak that skipped a cycle is not consecutive.
semantics.unobserved: for a last_receipt lane (one overwritten file) a slot whose receipt was replaced before the counter looked is unobserved and resets n; the counter therefore must run at least once per cadence interval.
semantics.verdict_given: a verdict already given is never downgraded: after n reached N the line is 'PRODUCTION VERIFIED · LIVE MATURITY n/N' until n = N again, but a failing or silent lane is shown first (FAILING · / SILENT ·).
semantics.timestamps: receipt timestamps without a zone are read as UTC; registry times are ET.
